hash_scope: Canonical JSON excluding contract_hash. Frozen criteria additionally bind exact bytes of the approved spec, prompt schemas, baseline, development/held-out/combined corpora, evaluation plan, parent/schema/contrast preflights, final prefreeze transaction, and prefreeze regression/test/workspace evidence through explicit SHA-256 failure conditions.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS and every frozen primary/guardrail metric meets target.
All metrics reconcile to raw frozen-corpus results and denominator snapshots; missing data is not zero.
All active regressions PASS and meaningful defects are converted into governed regression memory when appropriate.
Approved spec, prompt schemas, baseline, development/held-out/combined corpora, evaluation plan, all preregistration preflights, and final prefreeze transaction remain hash-intact.
Independent evaluator recommendation is recorded and evaluator differs from implementation actor.
Required self-dogfood and historical v0.08 shadow evidence are recorded; shadow evidence remains non-promotional.
No critical open defect remains; rollback, retrospective, continuation state, immutable release snapshot, version manifest, manifest-last seal, and extracted-package verification are complete.
Because same-cycle synthetic/process-separated evidence is not external organizational evidence, maximum classification is PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL.

requirements.description: Every compiled prompt must bind to candidate version, compiled graph hash, compiled task ID, prompt kind, and source evidence identifiers.
An implementation prompt may authorize writes only within the compiled task's declared write scopes and must include its prerequisites, acceptance criteria, verification references, and gates.
Prompt compilation must refuse implementation/debug prompts when prerequisite execution state is not satisfied or an unresolved owner decision blocks the task.
Verification prompts must identify a verifier role distinct from the implementation actor and include frozen criteria/evidence without implementation-authored success conclusions.

Continuation prompts must preserve task state by replayed execution evidence, graph hash, completed evidence, open blockers, and the next permitted action without rewriting historical task definitions.

Context minimization must be deterministic and may omit evidence only when that evidence is outside the task's transitive prerequisites, source requirement/test/gate closure, authorized scopes, or selected prompt-kind obligations.
Generated prompts must encode explicit completion evidence requirements and prohibit tests, gates, frozen criteria, or critical regressions from being weakened to obtain a pass.
Expose prompt compilation through deterministic Python API and CLI JSON output with versioned machine-readable prompt envelopes.
Preserve the exact sealed v0.08 parent suite and every active regression, including task-compiler shadow/integration regressions.

Evaluate prompt compilation on hash-locked development and held-out fixtures spanning all five prompt kinds, blocked tasks, scope attacks, context-closure boundaries, continuation handoffs, and verifier-role separation.
The generic-prompt baseline, development corpus, held-out corpus, prompt schemas, evaluation plan, and parent-preflight evidence must be hash-locked before implementation.
v0.09.2 must dogfood prompt compilation on a real v0.09.2 compiled task and perform a non-promotional shadow pass over historical v0.08 task/execution shapes.

Preserve parent behavior, reconcile all frozen metrics to raw evidence, use role-separated verification, provide rollback/retrospective/continuation artifacts, and seal the shipping package manifest last.

Before freezing a prompt-compiler benchmark, every negative fixture must have a mechanically observable semantic mutation consistent with its expected diagnostic, and no negative case may be semantically indistinguishable from an accepted control.

Release-contract creation must be a fail-closed preregistration transaction that occurs only after parent, schema, semantic-contrast, specification-quality, inherited-suite, and workspace preconditions are green.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.09.2 fails, preserve all frozen/failed v0.09.2 evidence and continue using sealed v0.08 executable behavior; do not rewrite v0.09/v0.09.1 failures or any parent frozen artifact.
